title: SpadlAction
description: One SPADL action as ETL GraphQL serves it (entity spadlActions, table dbo.spadlActions). Standard SPADL (socceraction 1.5.3) columns in camelCase, converted from MA3 by etl/reference/spadl.py, plus ETL extensions. A snapshot (matchId, s) reads rows with finalSeq <= s, for s <= matchWatermarks.spadlSeq.

actionId.description: SPADL action_id: 0, 1, 2… per match in action order; stable (rows are stored only once final and never renumbered).

originalEventId.description: MA3 id (the Opta event id); null for dribbles inserted between two actions.

timeSeconds.description: Seconds since the start of the period (inserted dribbles: midway between their neighbours).

teamId.description: Contestant id of the acting team.

startX.description: Metres. SPADL frame: the home team attacks towards x = 105 in every period; away actions are mirrored.

typeName.description: SPADL action type; non_action is never stored.

resultName.description: The Opta conversion never produces yellow_card or red_card: cards stay in rawEvents/keyEvents.

seq.description: Extension: canonical seq of the source MA3 row (its eventSeq); inserted dribbles take the next action's.

finalSeq.description: Extension: canonical seq after which this row cannot change; >= seq, non-decreasing in actionId. Shots and goals: their own seq; others: usually the next one or two actions; period_end finalises the rest of its period.

sourceEventId.description: Extension: the MA3 row's sourceEventId (the canonical MatchEvent event_id).

sourceTypeId.description: Extension: Opta type of the source MA3 row (e.g. 15 attempt saved, 16 goal, 49 ball recovery).

clockSeconds.description: Extension: broadcast match clock in seconds (period 2 starts at 2700), as matchWatermarks.clockSeconds.

videoSeconds.description: Extension: match video time of the source row.

possessionId.description: Extension: provider possession sequence of the source row.

bodypartObserved.description: Extension: a qualifier names the body part; false when SPADL's default (foot, or other for keeper actions) applies.

startZone.description: Extension: zone relative to the acting team (attacking towards the opponent's goal): thirds at 35 m and 70 m, penalty areas 16.5 m deep and 40.32 m wide split out.

fromShotOffTarget.description: Extension: the source MA3 row has Opta qualifier 190 (from shot off target). On a keeper_save: the keeper touched a shot that was going wide, not a save. False for inserted dribbles.

defensiveBlock.description: Extension: the source MA3 row has Opta qualifier 94 (defensive block). On a keeper_save: an outfield player blocked the shot, not a goalkeeper save. False for inserted dribbles.
